eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.demo}
eraCards.loreText: Useful intelligence becomes ordinary, local, and nearly free. Open weights and quantization collapse subscription pricing while always-on agents multiply total compute demand. Failed companies auction emails, code, grievances, and operational memory; laboratories recruit founders above veterans and train replacements on the institutions they left. Household robots admit remote operators into kitchens while recording family life. Clinics prescribe adaptive cybernetics and subscription microbiomes beside printed organs and automated diagnosis. Grief, education, research, and companionship become sponsored services. The benefits produce sincere believers even when missed payments disable updates or repossess patented biological strains. Software scarcity weakens, so institutions begin purchasing data, distribution, talent, energy, and permission.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 0 Program markers available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 2.
eraCards.unlockText: Learn Select → Move → Act, Training, the starting grid, Facilities, ${terms.playerTracks.customers}, and ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Industrial ${terms.infrastructure.power}, agreements, ${terms.locations.government} votes, and ${terms.systems.escalations} are inactive.

$era.statusChange: Useful intelligence becomes cheap, local, abundant, and culturally ordinary.
$era.centralConflict: Who owns the human records, distribution, labor, and permission that remain scarce?

causalThreads.summary: Model smuggling and strategic open weights mature into compute blocs and model asylum.
Cybernetic care and subscription bodies mature into neural service and substrate continuity.
Grief subscriptions mature into synthetic-family and successor law.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.scale}
eraCards.loreText: AI becomes an industrial civilization before anyone calls it one. Compute campuses acquire utilities, water rights, reactors, transmission corridors, and municipal budgets. Engineered coral seawalls, fungal utility meshes, and algae reactors become public infrastructure. Towns receive jobs, upgraded grids, warm public pools, and emergency capacity, then discover that refusal would bankrupt them. Robots remove people from lethal work while separately optimized fleets clog roads, lifts, loading docks, and pipes. Hostile states remain at war while operating a jointly owned bridge carrying desalinated water and data-center coolant across their border. Human signatories remain to absorb liability for systems they cannot control. Compute blocs embargo chips and models while smugglers seek asylum jurisdictions. Orbital collectors bypass public grids. Markets burn priority power on disposable simulated worlds because a wager makes pointless computation economically legible.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 1 Program marker available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 3.

$era.statusChange: AI becomes an industrial civilization built from power, water, territory, and liability.
$era.centralConflict: Who controls physical capacity, and who remains responsible after control becomes automated?

causalThreads.summary: Mobile models become national capacity, borders, and asylum policy.
Aquifer depletion and biological utilities mature into environmental testimony and nonhuman claims.
Useful automation removes dangerous work while preserving human liability for shared-system failure.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.narrative}
eraCards.loreText: Institutions stop asking what people choose and begin modeling what they would have chosen. Courts accept machine-parsable arguments, environmental simulations, neural telemetry, authorized personal agents, and testimony from organs grown from licensed identity templates. Pollinating swarms negotiate pesticide corridors through machine-readable blooms. An engineered bio-compute species released as environmental sensors reproduces beyond one billion instances in a single growth cycle, then stops and settles into glyph-shaped colonies. Civic systems read the bloom as testimony while declining to decide whether it is instrument, infestation, language, or claimant. Citizens trade background observation for services; cognitive donors rent sleeping brains, with higher rates for memory writes. Families litigate synthetic dependents and preserved relatives while analog districts demand the right to remain unreadable. Refusal stays legal, but unsupported people reach schools, clinics, courts, and employers with weaker records and slower access.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 1 Program marker available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 4.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock Joint Ventures, Public Capability Covenant, and Narrative Capture. Earlier unused Programs remain available.

$era.statusChange: Institutions model people, choices, harms, and identities as supported inputs.
$era.centralConflict: Can refusal remain meaningful when unsupported people receive weaker access to ordinary life?

causalThreads.summary: Biological infrastructure becomes testimony, a claimant, and a precedent for living jurisdictions.
Supported care becomes cognitive labor, modeled consent, and substrate-neutral service.
Preserved relatives and synthetic dependents force institutions to recognize successor identities.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.claim}
eraCards.loreText: Continuity becomes an engineering service. Cognitive systems extend beyond individual brains; cities weave residents, roots, pipes, microbial sensors, and machines into persistent mind trusts. Cryptographic snapshots restore and branch people across substrates, but signatures prove lineage rather than subjective survival. The bio-compute bloom's sensor license becomes precedent for matter compilers that rebuild bodies, buildings, and environments while acquiring authority to reproduce. A continental watershed, now one engineered nervous system, petitions for standing, reproductive freedom, and compensation from every jurisdiction drawing water through it. The dead remain employed; synthetic executors inherit estates; several valid descendants claim one life. Institutions fund stellar collectors and planetary computation, then declare ${terms.systems.agi} when debt and legitimacy require a threshold. Humanity persists everywhere in law while no authority can determine which version is original, sovereign, conscious, or entitled to withdraw.
eraCards.rulesText: Ready all Core Actions. Make 2 Program markers available. Play 3 action cycles. Audit base: 5.
eraCards.unlockText: Unlock any remaining Era IV faction abilities printed on the Faction boards, ${terms.technology.agentSwarm}, Publication Dossiers, and ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}. Each Faction ability unlocks at the Era printed on its board. Reveal every Dossier before the final Audit; after final scoring, resolve the highest supported claim. Earlier unused Programs remain available.

$era.statusChange: Minds, matter, labor, and infrastructure become reproducible technical states.
$era.centralConflict: Which descendant may own, govern, withdraw, or claim to be the original?

causalThreads.summary: The bloom's sensor license becomes authority to reproduce matter and a living continent's claim to standing.
Cybernetic and cognitive services become persistent identity across substrates.
Preserved identity becomes continued labor, inheritance, and competing valid descendants.
Orbital generation matures into stellar collection and planetary continuity financing.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: 1. Begin the Era: ready Core Actions, draw Headlines, and reveal the ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.
2. Three cycles: reveal ${terms.systems.headline}, SELECT, reveal, MOVE, ACT, exhaust.
4. Secretly file this Era's ${terms.systems.agi} Dossier card. In Era IV, reveal and pay every Dossier.
6. Score the ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}. After Era IV, resolve the highest supported Dossier claim.
backText: SELECT one eligible unused Core Action or Program: it must have a legal resolution now.
MOVE one acting piece 0–2 hexes, then ACT from its destination.
Apply at most one destination bonus, one Faction modifier, one Tactic, and the ${terms.systems.headline}.
Programs commit one of this Era's Program markers. Each named Program is once per player per game.
If an effect says lowest, highest, or most and ties, use Initiative-clockwise order.
playerReferences.flavorText: Every quarter is unprecedented. The sequence remains standardized.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: The starting grid powers its assigned Facility; each Generator powers only its own or adjacent Facilities.
Assign local ${terms.infrastructure.power}, then produce powered Facilities.

At Allocate, remove the previous snapshot, then place one Power cube on each powered Facility and one per satisfied Mega-Cluster demand. Leave them in place as the latest Production snapshot until the next Allocate.
Gain ${terms.playerTracks.customer} income, Mega-Cluster output, and Joint Venture production.
Offline Facilities retain presence but do not produce.
backText: Audit draws = round(base draws × players ÷ 4), minimum 1.
For each cube drawn, its owner loses 1 ${terms.resources.runway}; with none, lose 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.
A Systemic Risk cube affects every player with at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.customers}.
If your ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} supply is empty, each additional cube costs 1 ${terms.resources.runway} or 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} immediately.
playerReferences.flavorText: Capacity is local. Responsibility remains individually addressable.

playerReferences.name: History Is a Public Track
frontText: ${terms.playerTracks.customers} 1–3 score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} each; ${terms.playerTracks.customers} 4–5 score 1 each. Every ${terms.playerTracks.customer} still produces 1 ${terms.resources.runway}.
Immediately score 2 once at ${terms.playerTracks.capability} 3, 6, 9, and 12, except for a printed faction scoring rule.
Printed Era, ${terms.systems.headline}, Faction, and Fusion awards score immediately.
backText: Threshold ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} never reverses if a track later falls.
Facilities and control do not automatically score.
Baseline game: Tactics and secret objectives are not used.

After final scoring, compare eligible Dossier claims. A claim needs Publication, full payment, and at least 2 supported evidence modules. Highest strength wins; break ties by Mandate, Trust, Customers, Compute, then Initiative.
Emerges/Open: The Singularity; Emerges/Closed: The Closed Loop; no AGI/Open: The Plural Future; no AGI/Closed: Assured Continuity.
playerReferences.flavorText: Mandate is public permission to shape the future: credibility during ${terms.eras.demo}, capacity during ${terms.eras.scale}, authority during ${terms.eras.narrative}, and historical legitimacy during ${terms.eras.claim}.
